what_this_is: The committed lane runner's own classify output for the THIRD broad run, kept verbatim. Run 3 was required because deriving the readiness verdict edited two scripts under scripts/pettripfinder/, which regression_delta classifies as a runtime change and therefore MANDATORY_FULL. It re-proves the same failure set at the final commit, and it also covers the report, packet and test gates that run 2 predated.
why_passed_grew: the seven gates this order added to its own suite; no previously passing test changed state
verdict: CLEAN -- 0 TRUE_NEW_FAILURE at the final commit
source_commit_provenance: Run 3 executed at f2cc0b3. That commit was rewritten to ee1ce3d because three commits had been authored with a plain email address that the remote rejects under its privacy setting, so the author was reset to the repository's configured noreply address. The two trees differ in exactly one string -- the packet's own source_commit field, re-pinned to the rewritten source commit -- which no test reads at run time and which therefore cannot move a test outcome. ee1ce3d is the reachable commit whose tree this run proves.
